mapper.select:
Select m.id, m.profile_image, m.name AS nickname, m.unique_id AS user_id, m.status AS member_status,
CASE WHEN m.role = 'ROLE_CREATOR' THEN 'CREATOR' WHEN m.role = 'ROLE_USER' THEN 'USER' ELSE 'NONE' END AS creator_status, m.created_at
FROM member m WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN LOWER(m.name) LIKE CONCAT(LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(m.unique_id) LIKE CONCAT(LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(m.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
m.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
Select COUNT(*) FROM member m WHERE 1 = 1

sql.if: AND ( LOWER(m.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(m.unique_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

choose.when: AND (m.role IS NULL OR m.role NOT IN ('ROLE_CREATOR', 'ROLE_USER'))

mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.profile_image, m.name AS nickname, m.unique_id AS user_id, m.email, m.status AS member_status,
CASE WHEN m.role = 'ROLE_CREATOR' THEN 'CREATOR' WHEN m.role = 'ROLE_USER' THEN 'USER' ELSE 'NONE' END AS creator_status, m.created_at,
CASE WHEN m.role = 'ROLE_CREATOR' THEN 4900 ELSE NULL END AS subscription_price,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscription s WHERE s.creator_id = m.id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS subscriber_count
FROM member m WHERE m.id = #{memberId}
